text:
Rae Kim: Postmortem follow-up: finalizing owners for GPU/autoscale remediation. Need owners, small validation plan, and a 1-page on-call playbook.
Evan Brooks: I can own scheduler changes + PR.
Maya Singh: I will take quota guardrail + finance sync.
Arun M.: I can run replay tests and validate headroom.
Rae Kim: Scope: (A) quota backstop + cooldown, (B) scheduler smoothing & pod packing, (C) headroom verification harness, (D) slow-ramp/surge heuristics, (E) 1-page on-call playbook.
Evan Brooks: Scheduler summary: increase min_ready_nodes to 18%, add 30s rolling average to scale decisions, tighten pack thresholds so GPUs hit >65% before scale-up. Will include canary manifest (5% traffic) and revert snippet.
Maya Singh: Quota idea: allow 8% burst buffer with hard cap per org and automated cooldown (30m). Need finance approval for spend delta. I'll draft the ticket.
Arun M.: Validation plan: staging replay with 36h slow-ramp and 20m burst. Ill capture p50/p95/p99, avg_gpu_util, and cache_hit_rate. ETA: Tue morning.
Devon Li: OpsBot created task AS-998: "gpu-capacity-closure" assigned to Evan Brooks, Maya Singh, Arun M.. Due 2024-12-11. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/tasks/AS-998
Rae Kim: Detection heuristic: current alert uses instant token rate. Propose add a 30m derivative detector: if token_rate increases >15% over 30m AND avg_gpu_util > 70% -> trigger. Sarah (ops) previously suggested similar.
Evan Brooks: Ill include a small fuzz test and a perf table in the PR: baseline vs patched (latency, cost, scale events per hour). Smoke command: `./ci/smoke_autoscale --nodes 4 --ramp 900`.
Maya Singh: Monitoring snippet for quota alert suggestion:
```
SELECT mean(gpu_util) FROM infra.metrics WHERE cluster='prod' AND time > now()-10m
```
Alert if mean(gpu_util) > 86% for 6m.
Arun M.: Ill attach CSV with `gpu_pool` column so finance can attribute spend per pool.
Rae Kim: Action items (short):
- Evan Brooks - Scheduler PR + canary + rollback steps - due 2024-12-09
- Maya Singh - Quota proposal + finance request + monitoring query - due 2024-12-07
- Arun M. - Staging replay + result CSV - due 2024-12-05
- Rae Kim - 1-page on-call playbook and post in #incidents - due 2024-12-08
OpsBot: AS-998 status: 4 actions recorded, 3 owners assigned, finance pending. Next reminder scheduled 2024-12-03 16:00 UTC.
Evan Brooks: Question: who runs rollbacks in a regression? I can revert but need triage handoff.
Rae Kim: Triage = oncall primary. PR must include `kubectl rollout undo` snippet and a short health-check script run after revert.
Maya Singh: Finance: I pinged @Ethan. Will escalate if no response by EOD.
Arun M.: After staging run Ill post a tiny table: seed,qps,p95,avg_gpu_util,cache_hit. Should be 8 rows max.
Rae Kim: Constraint: infra changes must run a 10m canary with auto rollback if error rate >1% or latency increases >25% vs baseline.
Evan Brooks: Noted; will add canary automation and a flag to disable.
Maya Singh: Also adding `gpu_pool` and `workload_tag` to alerts so finance + teams can filter.
Rae Kim: Thanks all. Update AS-998 as you progress and ping this thread with blockers. :thumbsup:
